title: Synthetic interview fixture
logline: At a fictional wedding, Mara confronts a stranger who claims her fiance has another family.

events.text: Mara drops her bouquet and faces the stranger.

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: This is my wedding. Who sent you?

events.speaker: STRANGER
events.text: Ask him why he has hidden his family for five years.
The groom steps between them and reaches for the envelope.

events.speaker: GROOM
events.text: I can explain. Let me see the photograph.
The stranger pulls a second sealed envelope from her coat.
